t: You're standing on Wellington Road, a street in St John's Wood, in the City of Westminster. It forms part of the A41 route. The name comes from Arthur Wellesley, the first Duke of Wellington. He was a British Army officer and statesman, a leading figure in early nineteenth-century politics, who served as Prime Minister and as Commander-in-Chief of the Forces. So the road carries the name of one of the period's most prominent public men, and it's worth knowing that whenever you see his title on a street sign.
